messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-87321 triggered: threshold breach on /generate (5xx rate > 3% over 2m) — severity: P1. Auto-page to eng-oncall.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout v2026.03.15-rc3 -> prod started at 3178008800. Noting canary group A (10%) and B (5%).
alice: acked. taking on-call. seeing p95 error spike on canary-A. pulling logs now.
ben: +1. I can confirm increased 503s from front proxy to runtime at ~3178008900. tracing a subset of requests to kv-hotpath failures. putting alert into 'investigating'.
fiona: logs show repeated KV timeout + "recv timed out" from model-kv-store. sample trace id: 0x9f1a3b. gRPC deadline exceeded in stack: runtime/kvclient -> runtime/kvcache.
dave: infra note: we pushed a config to kvcache reconnect backoff earlier in the canary (temporary) — rolling that change is possible. checking recent infra deploys.
emily: CS triage: two enterprise customers reported increased generation errors and one demo session got dropped. Emily collecting customer IDs now.
incident-bot: Autopage escalation: no ack from primary after 1m -> paging rotation to secondary.
alice: acknowledged on primary. added ben and fiona. will escalate if >5m.
claire: product: which customers impacted? trying to assess impact on SLAs for accounts on Dedicated.
emily: affected: acme-inc (demo), finco-llc (prod), beta-team (staging but heavy usage). severity: finco-llc saw 18% request error rate for ~3m.
ben: quick mitigation idea: divert canary traffic back to stable (v2026.02.28) using rollout abort/traffic-swap. We can also disable the kvcache reconnect patch on canary nodes.
fiona: I can test disabling kvcache patch on one canary subset. if that helps, we can rollback the full release.
dave: infra: disabling the patch requires a config flip in configstore -> apply to cluster namespace 'canary' only. command:

```
# disable kvcache reconnect patch on canary
kubectl -n infra rollout restart configmap/kvcache-config -o yaml --patch '{"data":{"connect_backoff":"default"}}'
```

ben: also opening PD incident: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-87321 (assigned to alice). adding timeline notes.
alice: running the config flip now on a single canary pod. will monitor 60s.
incident-bot: PD-87321: acknowledge recorded by alice at 3178009080.
fiona: after the flip sample logs look cleaner — no immediate recv timeout in the next 30s on that pod. still validating p95 and error rate overall.
ben: p50/p90 improved on the flipped pod but aggregate still elevated (because other canary pods still have the patch). Suggest rolling back canary traffic to stable to stop customer impact immediately.
claire: agree. product wants minimal customer impact. recommend traffic-swap to stable while we troubleshoot offline. notify customers.
emily: drafting messages to impacted customers: short note, we detected an error surge, rollback in progress, ETA ~10m, will follow up with root cause. share for review: "We're rolling back a recent canary change that caused intermittent generation failures. No data loss. We'll post an update when rollback finishes." 
alice: Initiating traffic-swap rollback (canary -> stable). Command (cloudroll):

```
redwoodctl rollout abort --release v2026.03.15-rc3 --swap-to v2026.02.28 --reason "canary 5xx spike"
```
dave: infra watch: starting swap, diverting 100% of canary routing to stable. keep healthchecks on for 5m post-swap.
incident-bot: PD-87321: escalate to SRE lead after 3m not resolved. (escalation posted)
ben: swap in flight. current traffic now: stable 100%, canary 0% (3178009445). monitoring metrics.
fiona: tailing logs: error rate dropping on egress proxies. kv timeouts gone from 2.4% -> 0.2% in the past 2m on affected regions.
emily: customer notify sent to acme-inc and finco-llc (outbound). copy: "Rollback executed; errors reduced; monitoring closely; will follow up with RCAs." 
claire: product: confirming no feature flags toggled that would affect other regions? we should check rollout metadata for side effects.
dave: checked: rollout only touched kvcache connect config and a minor runtime param. both are reverted now.
alice: marking PD incident as mitigated. will remain on monitoring for 30m before resolving. PD note: mitigation at 3178009520.
incident-bot: PD-87321: status updated to 'mitigated' by alice.
ben: post-mortem actions (quick): 1) tighten kvcache patch rollout gating (smoke tests). 2) Add targeted canary healthcheck for KV latency. 3) Improve autopager message content to include affected config hashes. 4) Customer follow-up RCA.
fiona: will open a Github issue with the failing patch diff and link to logs + traces.
emily: scheduling customer follow-up calls with finco-llc for next-day. Claire can join.
claire: thanks. can we get an initial RCA draft in 24h? include timeline, root cause (kvcache reconnect backoff change), mitigation steps, and who was paged.
alice: will write initial RCA and ping this thread. closing notes: thank you team for quick action. marking thread resolved after post-monitoring window.
incident-bot: Thread closed. Autopage suppression enabled for the same alert for 30m to avoid noisy retries.
